game_title: C Scope Circuit · Global initialization · variation 7
game_concept: A puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Summit Spire, the highest spire: the mountaineer must handle storm winds while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Key Vault: Look up values in a dictionary by key to open the supply cache.
theme: Frost Peaks – Summit Spire: the highest spire
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Build 3 parallel branches, merge every branch by SUM, and feed the merged signal back for 2 passes before the output probe. In the scope controller, observe zero-initialized file-scope state. Print the scope trace [11, 0], then send the incoming signal with writeOutput(signal) into the broadcast splitter. Final file-scope values: {'steps': 0}. Pass all 3 signal tests.
controls: Drag components and connect pins. A splitter broadcasts a copy to every branch; the SUM merger waits for one result from each branch in the same pass. LOOP sends intermediate results back to split, and the final result to output. Select Program node to edit each C controller. Run tests every case; Step highlights the active node, wire and C line. Each node invocation starts fresh C scopes. Feedback passes and execution are bounded. readInput and writeOutput are bounded LogiCade helpers from logicade.h, not standard C functions.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Key Vault' (Week 8 slot 7), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Summit Spire'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Read the C scope mission and expected signal traces.
Connect sensor → scope controller → splitter; wire each branch into the SUM merger.
Write file-scope declarations before main and local declarations inside their blocks.
Connect merger → LOOP, LOOP → split and LOOP → output. Set the required feedback passes.
Use Program node to edit every branch. Step inspects scopes and signals; Run verifies all tests.
source_player_objective: Reach the supply cache using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The supply cache reached with actions_used <= 19.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the supply cache is reached, or lives reach 0.
hint: Wire every splitter branch into the SUM merger. The feedback controller repeats the merged signal for the required pass count, then sends it to the probe. Declare globals before main. Braces create local scopes; an inner declaration hides an outer name until its block ends. Use Step to inspect the variable scopes and output trace.
